$comment: Accessibility exceptions for `make a11y` (ui/parity/a11y.mjs), like deviations.json for parity.
A violation is excepted only when every failing node sits inside `within` for that `rule`.
status: accepted = allowed by the standard; design = a design rule the standard flags, asked of Claude Design (it stays listed until Design rules).

exceptions.reason: A region keeps its old content dimmed and inert while it refreshes (handoff §6A.3, keep and dim); WCAG 1.4.3 exempts inactive components.
